entries.scope_authorized: Four things beyond APP-012. (1) NO inter-slice stop: on completing a slice, proceed directly into the next without reporting for permission, through slice 13. (2) After slice 13, a full-build audit for gaps, fixing what it finds and re-testing. (3) Then a CLOSING AUDIT AGAINST THE FROZEN BLUEPRINT, verified against the code, repeated until nothing remains — the completion claim 'nothing is remaining, ready to demo' may be made only when that loop closes clean. (4) The Workflow tool is explicitly permitted alongside the Superpowers protocol.
entries.compaction_contract: On context compaction the controller must re-read its state from disk rather than rely on recollection. The durable resume brief is docs/process/RESUME.md, which names the source fingerprint, every approval, the build order, the current position, the standing rules, and the path to every ledger. It is updated at each slice boundary and at every material ruling. git log and the ledgers are authoritative over memory.
entries.research_authorised: Reaffirmed and widened: where the frozen blueprint does not answer a question, internet R&D is authorised to resolve it. The §22 boundary stands — research informs technical and design decisions and never becomes an AVIIXA product fact by imitation.
entries.no_stop_clause: The client has withdrawn permission to stop for questions, suggestions or confirmations, explicitly including runs exceeding 24 hours. Stopping remains required only for the master prompt's own safety stops: a source-drift event, an irreversible or destructive operation, or a defect where every path forward is a guess. None of those is a check-in and each must be reported as a blocker with its evidence.
